target.title: refactor(ui): trim private helper exports
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Removes two Control UI helpers from the public module surface when they are only used by their owning modules.

## Why This Change Was Made

The stale-chunk reload and browser annotation helpers remain unchanged for their existing internal callers. Their unnecessary exports and matching dead-code baseline exemptions are removed.

## User Impact

No user-visible behavior changes. This narrows the internal Control UI API and reduces the unused-export baseline by two entries.

## Evidence

- `pnpm deadcode:exports` in Testbox `tbx_01kxbybk0zrejyy0xn5w5e9hsg`: passed, 5,976 baseline entries
- `pnpm test:serial ui/src/app/stale-chunk-reload.test.ts ui/src/components/browser/browser-annotation.test.ts`: 26/26 tests passed
- `pnpm check:changed -- scripts/deadcode-exports.baseline.mjs ui/src/app/stale-chunk-reload.ts ui/src/components/browser/browser-annotation.ts`: passed
- Fresh `gpt-5.6-sol` medium autoreview: clean locally and against `origin/main`
- All-open-PR path overlap audit: no conflicts for the three changed files
